summary: Special Order Part with all Data Remains in Quoted Status after Line Status Changes from Need Approval to Approved
reported_issue: When a line status is changed from Needs Approval/Authorization Required to Approved/Authorized, a requested Special Order Part with all data incorrectly stayed in Quoted status instead of updating to 'Auth to order' with an Order action.
expected_after_fix: A Special Order Part with all data should auto-update from Quoted to 'Auth to order' (action Order); if missing data (vendor or cost) it should update to 'Requested' status.
steps_i_followed: Ticket is marked OBSOLETE; confirmed it is still testable and in scope, then verified the behavior.

Used fixture WO S9-24917, line 3d37443f in status 'authorization_required' carrying two special-order (vendor-source) part requests: PR 199ff75e in 'Quoted' with full data (part# ZZAUTOTEST-1699 + vendor + cost 16.99), and PR 8b8152c1 in 'Requested' with no part#/vendor.
Changed the line status to authorized via POST /api/work-orders/lines/change-status (HTTP 200).
Re-read the line and inspected both part requests.
actual_now: After authorizing the line, the special-order part with full data transitioned from 'Quoted' to 'authorized_to_order' (label 'Auth to order'), i.e. the Order-able state. The other special-order part that is missing data remained in 'Requested'. Both outcomes exactly match expected_after_fix.
notes: Ticket status OBSOLETE with no fixVersion, but the described bug does not reproduce: the auth-time promotion for special-order parts works, including the 'missing data -> Requested' branch.
